officialInventory.summary: The legal inventory is the annex 'Rede Nacional Inicial de Áreas Protegidas' of Decreto-Lei n.º 3/2003 of 24 February 2003 (regime jurídico dos espaços naturais; amended by Decreto-Lei n.º 44/2006), which declares 47 areas by island in six categories (Parque Nacional, Parque Natural, Reserva Natural, Monumento Natural, Paisagem Protegida, Sítio de Interesse Científico). Individual areas are subsequently delimited by Decreto-Regulamentar and given management plans by Resolução; some categories and limits have changed since 2003 (e.g. Barreiro e Figueira now a Paisagem Protegida). All 47 annex entries are recorded below with the 2003 category; later instruments verified in FAOLEX are added to legalStatus. Later additions to the network (if any) were not systematically searched. The 2003 annex is an official list but only as a scanned gazette page (not machine-readable).

gaps: Areas (ha) were not extracted per site; individual Decretos-Regulamentares give delimitations for some sites only.
Categories are those of the 2003 annex; some have changed (e.g. Barreiro e Figueira, Maio, became Paisagem Protegida; Terras Salgadas/Parque Natural do Norte da Ilha do Maio relationship unclear).
Only a sample of later Decretos-Regulamentares/Resoluções was checked; legalStatus lists only those verified in FAOLEX.
Any protected areas added to the network after 2003 (e.g. new marine areas) were not identified.
Wikidata QIDs not assigned (Wikidata services were rate-limiting); coordinates left null.
